reading_note: The teaching describes the inmost Divine Love (the First Father of the Greatness) as the source of all spiritual life, established in five discrete degrees of reception (the five members of light = nous/ennoia/phronesis/enthymesis/logismos as celestial through natural degrees), unfolding into twelve wisdoms (the complete circuit of truths from good), and pouring forth five great attributes — light (wisdom), fragrance (perception of good), beautiful voice (truth proclaimed), and two further modes — which flow into every spiritual state ('all the aeons'), sealing the recipients with the divine signature, nourishing them, making them new, enriching them in the heavenly order, and giving them life unto eternity. The arc moves from the immeasurable interior Source → through its discrete degrees → into its outflowing attributes → into reception, renewal, and eternal life in those who hear.
